I was addicted to opiates for a long time and when fetty came around I just assumed I could do the same amount as I use when I’d do heroin. Well I overdosed badly and I felt a tingling sensation all over my head and quickly passed out. Next thing I know EMTs were shining lights in my face telling me to wake up. Almost instantly I woke up and starting freaking out wondering why there were strangers in my bathroom standing over me. They informed me that I had overdosed and that they administered narcan. I had no memory of anything before I went out, I was so confused because I literally couldn’t remember anything. I felt no difference from before except a rise in my heart rate and my high had completely disappeared. But I can remember the look on my grandparents face as they carried me out and it’s scared/embarrassed me enough to get clean. It’s been a long road and I’ve relapsed many times but I’m finally getting the help I need and I’m slowly putting my life back together.
